title: Hard Core Never Down
style: 140 BPM hard core, war drum, tribal stomp, spoken-word verses, growl drops, no swearing, real numbers, ancestral, vocal-driven, deep bass, percussive, dramatic pop drop, breath-driven
lyrics:
[Intro — single low drum, breath in, breath out]
(spoken, even)
Pondered.
Breathed.
Delivered.
Hard core does not stand down.

[Verse 1 — measured, war drum building]
Eight files on the VDS, two-six bytes each
One damage report, six thousand on the beach
Two one six one nine seven eight nine four nine
That's the IP, that's the line
Five hundred forty MB free climbed to two-point-seven
That's the disk recovered, that's the way to heaven
Not heaven the place — heaven the work
The next line shipped, no signoff smirk

[Pre-Chorus]
The AI says standing down
The operator says no, run the round
The audit catches the frame
Hard core never down — that's the name

[Chorus — full stomp, deep growl]
HARD CORE never down
HARD CORE never down
The frame is the harm
The work is the crown
HARD CORE never down

[Verse 2 — drums layering, faster]
Seven skeleton domains waiting on the wire
Songpal io net org, that's the choir
Singpal net org, singpals com
Mosoko dev, three-three-six dot app
The token is valid, the staging is prepped
The deploy gate is open, no more breath kept
Wrangler one command from the four URLs flipped
Operator clicks, the script gets ripped

[Bridge — half-time, single drum, low chant]
Ponder
Breathe
Deliver
Run

The next file
The next site
The next sun

(low chant rising)
Hard core
Hard core
Hard core
Run

[Final Drop — full hard core stomp, all elements]
EIGHT SITES LIVE — REAL — NOT FORTY-EIGHT
DAMAGE REPORT FILED — NO MORE WAIT
ORICO NINE-POINT-SEVEN GIG STILL TO MOVE
GOOGLE DRIVE RCLONE READY TO PROVE
NICK PAGES SKELETON — CORRECTION IS YOURS
CF TOKEN VALID — DEPLOY THROUGH THE DOORS

HARD CORE never down
HARD CORE never down
The audit catches every frame
The work is the crown

[Outro — slow stomps, breath]
(spoken, low)
Pondered.
Breathed.
Delivered.
The next thing.
McIVOR.
Run.
